channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jason Smith | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jason Smith from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Brandon Jennings on Jason Smith
item.description:
“Jason Smith didn’t do anything wrong anyway. All he did was set a good pick, so for you to come at a guy like Jason Smith, who’s not even a bad guy or don’t do things like that – so what are you doing? I was just protecting my teammate.”

Brandon Jennings on Jason Smith, Mar 8, 2017. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Phil Jackson on Jason Smith, Shane Larkin
item.description:
Jackson:

“Jason Smith has really stepped up his game, and before he got hurt, so had Shane Larkin. Unfortunately, Shane hasn't grown any since the start of the season. Tim Hardaway still shows great potential but has been inconsistent. Jose Calderon expects perfection, and since our operation of the triangle -- while improving -- remains far from perfect, Jose gets frustrated. When that happens, he gets tight and makes mistakes. Overall, though, and more often than not, everybody plays hard.”

Phil Jackson on Jason Smith, Shane Larkin, Jul 27, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Derek Fisher on Jason Smith
item.description:
“Jason Smith originally was out for personal reasons, so once Jason was back, Cole had played some, it was important that we got Jason some minutes so we could see how he might be able to help us,”

Derek Fisher on Jason Smith, Oct 19, 2014. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Eric Gordon on Jason Smith, Anthony Davis
item.description:
“You look at our roster right now, what do we have, one big? Jason Smith? Before Anthony Davis, we had no bigs.”

Eric Gordon on Jason Smith, Anthony Davis, Jul 6, 2012. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.
